t.template.how:
Place .html template files in templates/SIZE/ directories (e.g., templates/1080x1920/). Templates are automatically grouped by size. Custom CSS styles are supported.

**Template Naming Convention**

- `static_*.html` → Static style templates (no AI-generated media)
- `image_*.html` → Image generation templates (AI-generated images)
- `video_*.html` → Video generation templates (AI-generated videos)

**Note**

At least one of the following browsers must be installed on your computer for proper operation:
1. Google Chrome (Windows, macOS)
2. Chromium Browser (Linux)
3. Microsoft Edge

t.flxw.source.generate_scene_caption: 🎨 This scene is AI-generated — its media is produced in the Scenes step (with the other generation steps).
t.flxw.source.not_sourced_warning: Search scenes without applied media will fetch + auto-pick automatically in the Scenes step.
t.flxw.final.credits_hint: Pexels/Pixabay content is free to use; crediting the photographers is appreciated.
t.flxw.setup.search_only_help: Every scene uses real stock media: the AI plans search keywords for all scenes, and an empty search retries with broader keywords instead of falling back to AI generation. No generation model is ever loaded — the video needs only TTS + ffmpeg (no GPU).
t.flxw.plan.search_only_info: 🔒 Stock-only project — every scene is planned as a stock search; empty searches retry with broader keywords and never fall back to AI generation.
t.flxw.setup.resume_saved_info: 💾 Found an unfinished project: "{title}" — {ready}/{total} scenes ready (saved {saved}). Resume it instead of starting over (e.g. after a dropped tunnel/browser session).
